macro.title: US-Iran Tensions

macro.body: The recent market trends suggest a rotation from tech to other sectors, which could impact the portfolio's performance. The tech sector has been a significant contributor to the portfolio's gains, and a rotation away from tech could lead to a decrease in the portfolio's value.

macro.base: The current sector rotation could lead to a neutral impact on the portfolio, as the gains in other sectors offset the losses in tech.
macro.bear: A significant rotation away from tech could lead to a decrease in the portfolio's value, negatively impacting the portfolio's performance.

risks.title: Leverage Amplification Risk
risks.body: The portfolio's high leverage amplifies both gains and losses, making it susceptible to significant market fluctuations. A downturn in the market could lead to a substantial decrease in the portfolio's value.

risks.title: FX Exposure Risk
risks.body: The portfolio's significant USD exposure makes it vulnerable to fluctuations in the USD/CAD exchange rate. A strengthening of the CAD could lead to a decrease in the portfolio's value.

risks.title: Earnings Concentration Risk
risks.body: The portfolio's concentration in a few top holdings makes it susceptible to significant losses if any of these holdings experience a downturn. However, the current holdings have a strong track record of performance.
